chunks: And what you do not see
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'what you do not see'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the epistemological limits of human senses, pointing to the 'Alam al-Ghayb' (Realm of the Unseen) which is fully accessible only through divine revelation and the insight of the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a theological foundation for accepting metaphysical truths, such as the Imamate and resurrection, which transcend empirical verification.
